diagnosis.raw_to_final: Raw proposal quality is not the sole bottleneck; thresholding, exclusive ownership, and residual assignment materially change the final operating point.
diagnosis.feedback_intervention: Disabling feedback on the same single-environment FULL checkpoints did not improve final F1; this is an inference intervention, not a trained ablation.

claim_allowed: With a frozen ReScene/Concerto backbone, observation attention plus feedback improved final instance discrimination on shared OVI input support over ordinary fine-tuning and simple fusion on three DEV environments and retained a smaller aggregate gain on two predeclared CONFIRM environments.
claim_not_supported: Full-scene recovery, persistent identity recovery, SOTA, open-vocabulary generalization, low Ghost, or statistically stable multi-seed superiority.
highest_value_next_action: Repeat OBS_BASE_TUNED and OBS_FULL with the same six environments and seed 46, then evaluate both on the unchanged DEV and CONFIRM sets.
